title: Head of Deployment
leads: The operators on your own sites, and every new site's team on launch day.
where: New sites in launch weeks, your own sites the rest of the time, and the store
hours: Clock-in at 7:00 AM, six days a week. A launch takes the whole day
summary: You open every new site: gear, launch day, first lesson. And you run your own sites.

posting.headline: Head of Deployment (new sites, training, and gear), Cairo
posting.about: We run video recording teams at factories, warehouses, farms, and construction sites across Cairo. Workers wear a small camera on a cap while they do their normal job. The Head of Deployment opens every new site: the gear order, launch day with the Portfolio Manager, and the first-day lesson for new operators and Portfolio Managers. You also run sites of your own.
do: Run your own portfolio of sites and reach its monthly hour target.
Fill every gear order: phones, mounts, caps, chargers, and spares at ten percent.
Enroll, tag, and test every phone before it joins a kit.
Hand the kit to the Portfolio Manager on launch morning. Count it together. Both sign.
Run launch day: charging stations, labels, network test, first lesson, pilot recordings.
Own the first-day lessons for operators and Portfolio Managers. Keep them current.
Order through Mano before the spare pool falls under ten percent.
need: You have run a floor: a factory, a warehouse, or a site.
Able to teach a job in plain words and check that it stuck.
Careful with a list. Every phone, every count, every signature.
On your feet across Cairo, six days a week.
plus: You have been an operator or a Portfolio Manager with us.
You have opened a new site or a new shift somewhere before.
offer: A steady monthly wage, paid on time.
Your first order and your first launch with the Director of Operations beside you.
A clear procedure for the gear and for launch day.
You are the named deputy of the Director of Operations.
posting.apply: Send your name, age, where you live, a phone number, and the floors you have run. We call back within two working days.

offer.heading: Offer of employment
paragraphs: We are pleased to offer you the position of Head of Deployment at KMSC. You will report to {manager}, the Director of Operations.
Your start date is {start}. You fill your first gear order and run your first launch day with {manager} beside you.

terms.label: Place of work
terms.v: Based at {site}, moving between new sites, your own sites, and the store

terms.v: Clock-in at 7:00 AM, six days a week. A launch takes the whole day

terms.v: {pay} per month, paid at the end of the month

conditions: A copy of your national ID.
Your signature on the rules, the consent form, and the fraud briefing.
One account in your own name. Accounts are never shared.
Your first launch day, signed off by {manager}.
expect: No site launches short. A kit is whole, or launch day moves.
Every phone you hand over is enrolled, tested, and signed for.
Your own portfolio reaches its monthly target.
offer.closing: Please sign below to accept this offer. We look forward to working with you.

handbook.purpose: The client pays for accepted hours. A new site's hours start on a launch day that went right: a whole kit, a tested line, trained operators, clean pilots. You make that day happen at every new site, and you keep your own sites on target in between.
outcomes: Every new site launches on the day named, with a whole kit and trained operators.
Every phone you hand over is on the map, tested, and signed for.
The spare pool never falls under ten percent.
Your own portfolio reaches its monthly hour target.
daily: 7:00 AM. Clock in with your sites. Visit them without warning during the shift.
An order lands. Write the kit list and count the store with Mano the same day.
Store days. Enroll, tag, and test every phone. One 30-minute recording, uploaded.
Launch days. Count the kit, test the line, train, check every pilot, get Moharam's yes.
6:00 PM. Mano has the wrap report for your own sites.
weekly: Thursday, 4:00 PM. The three-way count: registry, MDM, and room say the same number.
Once a week. Check the spare pool with Mano. Under ten percent, order the same day.
monthly: Review the month's launches with Moharam: what was short, what moved, what to change.
standards: No site launches short. A kit is whole, or launch day moves.
A phone joins a kit only after it shows on the map and uploads a test.
Nobody signs for a count that is not their count.
Nothing written on the outside of a bag.
Nothing records for real before Moharam certifies the launch.
Gear through Mano, money to Ahmed Alaa, quality to Youssef Medhat. Nobody contacts the client.
never: A kit filled from another site's kit.
A phone that goes home, or an account that is shared, ends the job.
Saying the client's name to anyone outside the company ends the job.

firstMonth.what: In the store with Mano. The registry, the kit list, the tags, the order.
Fill one gear order end to end. Moharam checks every phone before the handover.
Run one launch day with Moharam there. Train the operators. Check every pilot.
Your own portfolio. Two wrap reports accepted in a row. Moharam signs you off.

measures: Launches on the day the schedule named, with a whole kit.
Phones handed over already on the map, with a test uploaded.
Days the spare pool was under ten percent.
Accepted hours in your own portfolio, against the monthly target.
handbook.call: Moharam, for the floor or a launch that will not hold. Mano for the store or the registry. Youssef Medhat for the schedule or a pilot. Ahmed Alaa for money. A missing bag: Moharam now.
